checks.text: The page heading is "File Converter" and the drop zone displays the text "Drop a file or click to browse".
After dropping a file named "report.pdf", the preview panel shows the filename "report.pdf" and the select labelled "Output format" contains the options "PDF", "PNG", and "JPG".

With "report.pdf" loaded, selecting "PNG" in the select labelled "Output format" and clicking the button "Convert" shows the status text "Converted report.pdf to report.png" and enables the button "Download".
Clicking the button "Download" after a successful conversion triggers a download of a file named "report.png".
After a successful conversion, the history list contains an item with the text "report.pdf → report.png".
Clicking the button "Clear history" removes all items from the history list and shows the text "No conversions yet".
After a successful conversion, reloading the page still shows the history item "report.pdf → report.png" and the status text "Converted report.pdf to report.png".

Dropping a file named "photo.jpg", selecting "PDF" in the select labelled "Output format", and clicking "Convert" shows the status text "Converted photo.jpg to photo.pdf" and adds a history item "photo.jpg → photo.pdf".
